<?php
function sensitive_ctor_arg26($value) { echo "A", $value, "|"; return $value; }
$value = 7;
$alias =& $value;
$wrapper = new \SensitiveParameterValue($alias);
$method = "__CoNsTrUcT";
$constructor = $wrapper->$method(...);
$method = "missing";
$value = 17;
echo $wrapper->getValue(), "|", $alias, "|";
try { $constructor(); }
catch (\ArgumentCountError $error) { echo $error->getMessage(), "|"; }
try { $constructor(sensitive_ctor_arg26(23), sensitive_ctor_arg26(29)); }
catch (\ArgumentCountError $error) { echo $error->getMessage(), "|"; }
try { $constructor(value: sensitive_ctor_arg26(31)); }
catch (\Error $error) { echo $error->getMessage(), "|"; }
echo $wrapper->getValue();

<?php
class SensitiveCtorLeaf26 {
    public function __construct(public string $label) {}
    public function __destruct() { echo $this->label, "|"; }
}
$leaf = new SensitiveCtorLeaf26("O");
$weak = \WeakReference::create($leaf);
$wrapper = new \SensitiveParameterValue($leaf);
$constructor = $wrapper->__construct(...);
unset($leaf, $wrapper);
echo $weak->get() === null ? "NO|" : "LO|";
$replacement = new SensitiveCtorLeaf26("R");
$replacementWeak = \WeakReference::create($replacement);
try { $constructor($replacement); }
catch (\Error $error) { echo "E|"; }
unset($replacement);
echo $replacementWeak->get() === null ? "NR|" : "LR|";
unset($constructor);
echo $weak->get() === null ? "NO|" : "LO|";
echo $replacementWeak->get() === null ? "NR|" : "LR|";
unset($error);
echo $replacementWeak->get() === null ? "NR|" : "LR|";

<?php
function sensitive_invoke_arg26($value) { echo "A", $value, "|"; return $value; }
$wrapper = new \SensitiveParameterValue(7);
$constructor = $wrapper->__construct(...);
$alias = $constructor->__invoke(...);
unset($constructor);
try { $alias->__invoke(sensitive_invoke_arg26(23)); }
catch (\Error $error) { echo $error->getMessage(), "|", $error->getTraceAsString(), "|"; }
try { $alias->__invoke(); }
catch (\ArgumentCountError $error) { echo $error->getMessage(), "|", $error->getTraceAsString(), "|"; }
try { $alias?->__invoke(sensitive_invoke_arg26(31)); }
catch (\Error $error) { echo $error->getMessage(), "|", $error->getTraceAsString(), "|"; }
echo $wrapper->getValue();

<?php
class SensitiveCtorCloneLeaf26 {
    public function __destruct() { echo "D|"; }
}
$leaf = new SensitiveCtorCloneLeaf26();
$weak = \WeakReference::create($leaf);
$wrapper = new \SensitiveParameterValue($leaf);
$constructor = $wrapper->__construct(...);
$copy = clone $constructor;
unset($leaf, $wrapper, $constructor);
echo $weak->get() === null ? "N|" : "L|";
try { $copy(value: 29); }
catch (\Error $error) { echo "E|"; }
unset($copy);
echo $weak->get() === null ? "N|" : "L|";
unset($error);
echo $weak->get() === null ? "N|" : "L|";

catch (\Error $error) { echo $error->getMessage(), "|"; }
try { $constructor(...["value" => sensitive_unpack_arg26(29)], value: sensitive_unpack_arg26(31)); }
